default.plan.name: Kestrel K1 launch, Q4
default.s1.name: Signed manufacturing contract → Tokyo
default.s1.desc: Originals, signature on delivery. Production slot closes in 3 days, so speed beats price.
default.s2.name: Review units → US press
default.s2.desc: One pocket synth with its lithium-ion battery installed. Batteries rule out most postal services.
default.s3.name: Backer batch → Sydney
default.s3.desc: A bulky but light carton. Volumetric weight punishes express carriers; postal parcels ignore it.
default.s4.name: Dev-kit carton → São Paulo
default.s4.desc: Customs country with thin data: estimates and quote-only freight keep the total honestly incomplete.
default.s5.name: Repair returns ← Tokyo
default.s5.desc: A return leg on a different route (JPN → DEU) that waits for the review units to be out.
default.s6.name: Flight case → Zurich trade fair
default.s6.desc: 22 kg and 100 cm: over every postal limit, so only the couriers qualify.
access.np: Open to everyone at a Nordpost counter or online. Online is cheaper. Demo carrier.
access.mx: Meridian Express list rates need no account. Drop off at a service point or book a pickup. Demo carrier.
access.ph: Parcelhub compares several carriers and shows one price. Quotes vary by day, so they are treated as estimates. Demo carrier.
access.af: Atlas Freight prices every shipment by e-mail and only serves businesses. Demo carrier.
limits.np_parcel: Economy Parcel: longest side 100 cm, length + girth 260 cm, up to 20 kg.
limits.np_parcel_aus: This destination accepts only 10 kg and smaller boxes.
limits.mx_box: Envelope up to 0.5 kg, Small Box up to 2 kg; the box is the limit, there is no volumetric weight.
tariff.np_list: Demo price list, EUR incl. VAT. No volumetric weight, the price follows actual weight.
tariff.np_brazil: Brazil: slow, and customs clearance is the recipient's risk.
tariff.mx_calc: Demo calculator rates, EUR excl. VAT and fuel surcharge.
tariff.mx_divisor: Dimensional weight: L×W×H cm ÷ 5000. The larger of actual and dimensional weight is charged.
tariff.mx_envelope: Fixed-price envelope and small box, incl. VAT and fuel.
tariff.ph_estimate: Sampled aggregator quotes in USD. Real prices depend on the carrier chosen on the day.
tariff.af_quote: Freight is quoted per shipment. No price is shown, so totals stay incomplete.
guide.intro: Pick a package type to see the recommended service. Prices are for the route selected in the form below.
guide.group.export.title: Launch shipments from Germany
guide.group.export.note: Compare the cheapest postal option with the express carriers. Batteries and size limits change the answer.
guide.group.export.note.BRA: Brazil: customs clearance and slow postal transit. Expect estimates and quote-only freight.
guide.group.returns.title: Returns to Germany
guide.group.returns.note: Only the express carrier covers Japan → Germany in this demo.
use.np-letter-registered: documents up to 2 kg when tracking matters but speed does not
use.np-parcel-economy: cheapest for non-urgent goods without batteries; no volumetric weight
use.np-parcel-priority: postal speed with tracking; batteries only packed with the device
use.mx-envelope: documents and small boxes with a signature, fixed price
use.mx-express: fastest and the safe pick for batteries and high value; dimensional weight applies
use.mx-economy: two to three days slower than Express for a clearly lower price
use.ph-best-rate: estimate only; compare it, then book with the carrier directly
use.af-consolidated: heavy freight; send a quote request, no price is shown here
